conf.description: zos-racf resource-access, format json: structural JSON extract only for the CDPz System Data Engine stream -- the SDE's own field/record names could not be retrieved for this work order entry, so no ECS mapping is attempted; the parsed object and _raw are both retained verbatim as the forensic backstop for this deliberately incomplete pipeline.

conf.comment: zos-racf/resource-access/json (CDPz System Data Engine SMF-80 stream). The work order's own fields_omitted note says the SDE key names for SMF type 80 'are published in IBM's CDPz SMF data stream reference but could not be retrieved for this entry,' and that the SDE splits SMF 80 into several related records, so even which record carries the access decision is unknown here. Inventing an ECS mapping without those key names would be exactly the unguessable-field-name case the brief says never to guess, so this pipeline only does the structural JSON extract (real parsing, not a pass-through) and stops there -- no rename, no event.outcome/event.action, no volume shaping. event.dataset/event.category are set as dataset-level constants since they don't depend on the SDE's field names. See README for the full gap list; this is a skeleton pending the SDE reference doc or a captured sample.

functions.description: document why ECS mapping was deliberately not attempted for the SDE fields
parse the Data Streamer's JSON object into fields (structure only -- SDE key names are unknown so nothing downstream renames or reads them individually)
dataset-level constants only, no hyphen in event.dataset; _raw is deliberately kept since the parsed SDE fields cannot yet be mapped or even verified against a real record
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
